map.Prüft das Plugin auf der Unterkunftsseit: The plugin checks these on the listing page, based on the reviews:
map.Mindestens passende Schlafzimmer in die: Carry a suitable minimum number of bedrooms over to the Airbnb search
map.Ohne Namen teilen (Mitreisende erscheine: Share without names (travel companions appear as “Person 1, 2 …”)
map.Mit dem Link öffnest du deine Suche auf: Use the link to open your search on another device or share it with your travel companions. The data is stored only in the link.
map.Daten: OpenStreetMap (Orte im Umkreis, n: Data: OpenStreetMap (places within the radius, closer ones count more). OpenStreetMap services are queried for place search, places and map tiles. Privacy policy (German).
map.Wie wird gewertet?: How is the score worked out?
map.Standardmäßig zählt (wenn ihr mehrere se: By default (if there are several of you) the least satisfied person counts for 60 % and the average for 40 %, so the majority does not simply win. Use the fairness slider to change the balance. The budget does not change the score, it only filters the Airbnb search. The price level of each neighbourhood is a rough estimate based on location and sights. If travellers or the radius change, the scores are recalculated straight away.
map.Etwas ging schief. Bitte die Seite neu l: Something went wrong. Please reload the page. If that does not help:
map.Stadt, Zeitraum, Budget und deine Wünsch: Enter a city, dates, budget and your wishes.
map.Gezählt werden Bars, Cafés, Parks, Sehen: We count bars, cafés, parks, sights and stops within the radius of each neighbourhood.
map.Mit Mitreisenden zählt die am wenigsten: With travel companions, the least satisfied person counts most, so the majority does not simply win.
map.Die Daten kommen live von OpenStreetMap,: The data comes live from OpenStreetMap, maintained by volunteers. Big cities take a little longer.
map.Die Städte unter „Beliebte Ziele“ sind v: The cities under “Popular destinations” are preloaded and appear instantly.
map.Ist eine Stadt einmal geladen, geht jede: Once a city has loaded, every further search there today runs without waiting.
map.Mit dem Plugin für Chrome siehst du auf: With the Chrome plugin you see the three best listings directly on Airbnb.
